items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: he played with me until I quit.

ctx.x: Well who are those people in the picture? There's a drummer.
Winnie Carter. Philip Nixon, Samuel Dutray, Albert Baptiste. Albert Baptiste? That's right. Philip Nixon and Jim Johnson.
Now that was the men all the way through until you quit the band? Until it broke up?
